finding: PRINTED: "During your turn, this spell costs {2}{U}{U} less to cast. End the turn. (Exile all spells and abilities from the stack, including this card...)" ENGINE(observed): the end-turn machinery works (Defiant Strike buff reverts, power/toughness back to 1/1, life 20) but "zone[dc]: expected exile, got graveyard" — the spell buries itself instead of the printed "including this card" exile. Cost reduction never applies: seed U:3 raises "executor: illegal cast: cost:mana_generic:0<3"; seed U:5 raises "cost:mana_generic:2<3"; full generic cost is charged. Green run used loose seed U:7/W:1.
